core_obligations: Combine the open mapping lemma with tautness of the homomorphism to obtain that the map is open (proof lines 1469-1472).
Upgrade openness to surjectivity using density of the image (proof lines 1472-1473).
Observe that the kernel K is closed because the homomorphism is continuous (proof lines 1473-1474).
Invoke the quotient lemma to conclude B = A/K and completeness of B (proof lines 1475-1476).
proof_roadmap: Openness from the open mapping lemma plus tautness (proof lines 1469-1472).
Closed kernel and quotient identification (proof lines 1473-1476).
difficulty_reason: Assume a continuous homomorphism of linearly topologized rings is taut with dense image, that the source is complete with a countable fundamental system of open ideals and that the target is separated; the lemma concludes that the map is surjective and open, that the target is complete and that it is a quotient of the source by a closed ideal (statement lines 1454-1465). The proof is displayed in full: the open mapping lemma for linearly topologized rings combined with tautness gives openness, density of the image upgrades openness to surjectivity, continuity makes the kernel closed, and the quotient lemma identifies the target with A/K and yields completeness (proof lines 1468-1476). The level is H2: four short steps, each with its justification named, none of them omitted.
